hook.en: Water flows from a high tank to a low one. In the same way positive charge moves from high potential to low potential. A 9 V battery keeps a 9 volt height difference between its terminals.
hook.kn: ನೀರು ಎತ್ತರದ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ತಗ್ಗಿನ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಧನ ಆವೇಶ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿಭವದಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಭವಕ್ಕೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 9 V ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ತನ್ನ ತುದಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 9 ವೋಲ್ಟ್ ವಿಭವಾಂತರವನ್ನು ಕಾಯ್ದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Define electrostatic potential and potential difference.
Find the potential of a point charge, a dipole and a system of charges.

narration.en: Water flows from a high tank to a low one. In the same way positive charge moves from high potential to low potential. A 9 V battery keeps a 9 volt height difference between its terminals.
narration.kn: ನೀರು ಎತ್ತರದ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ತಗ್ಗಿನ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಧನ ಆವೇಶ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿಭವದಿಂದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಭವಕ್ಕೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 9 V ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ತನ್ನ ತುದಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 9 ವೋಲ್ಟ್ ವಿಭವಾಂತರವನ್ನು ಕಾಯ್ದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The electrostatic potential at a point is the work done by an external force in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity to that point, slowly (without acceleration). The potential difference between A and B is the work per unit charge in taking a charge from A to B: $V_B - V_A = W_{AB}/q$. The SI unit is the volt: 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹. Potential is a scalar.
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ವಿಭವ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಧನ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ಅನಂತದಿಂದ ಆ ಬಿಂದುವಿಗೆ ತರಲು ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೆಲಸ. ವಿಭವಾಂತರ = W/q. ಏಕಮಾನ ವೋಲ್ಟ್ = J C⁻¹. ವಿಭವ ಅದಿಶ ಪರಿಮಾಣ.

points.en: Positive charge moves from high V to low V

narration.en: Potential at a point is the work done per unit positive charge in bringing it from infinity to that point. Potential difference is work per unit charge between two points. Its unit is the volt, one joule per coulomb.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ವಿಭವ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಧನ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ಅನಂತದಿಂದ ಆ ಬಿಂದುವಿಗೆ ತರಲು ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೆಲಸ. ವಿಭವಾಂತರ = W/q. ಏಕಮಾನ ವೋಲ್ಟ್ = J C⁻¹. ವಿಭವ ಅದಿಶ ಪರಿಮಾಣ.

title.en: Potential of a point charge, a dipole and a system

body.en: Point charge: $V = kq/r$, falling as 1/r (sign of q included). Dipole at distance r and angle θ from its axis: $V = kp\cos\theta/r^2$; it is zero everywhere on the equatorial plane. System of charges: add the potentials as numbers, with signs. Field and potential are linked by $E = -dV/dr$: E points in the direction in which V decreases fastest.
body.kn: ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶ: V = kq/r. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ: V = kp cosθ/r², ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. E = −dV/dr.

points.en: Dipole: V = kp cos θ/r²; zero on the equator

narration.en: For a point charge V is k q by r. For a dipole V is k p cos theta by r squared, zero on the equatorial plane. For many charges just add the potentials with their signs. The field is minus the rate of change of potential with distance.
narration.kn: ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶ: V = kq/r. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ: V = kp cosθ/r², ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. E = −dV/dr.

problem.en: Charges +2 μC, −2 μC, +4 μC and +1 μC are at the corners of a square of side √2 m. Find the potential at the centre.

steps.en: Each corner is half a diagonal from the centre: (√2 × √2)/2 = 1 m.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Charges +2 μC, −2 μC, +4 μC and +1 μC are at the corners of a square of side √2 m. Find the potential at the centre.

problem.en: The potential 10 cm from a point charge is 900 V. Find the charge and the field at that point.

steps.en: For a point charge E = kq/r² = V/r.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The potential 10 cm from a point charge is 900 V. Find the charge and the field at that point.

body.en: For a single point charge, kq/r² is just (kq/r)/r, so E = V/r. And remember: potentials add as plain numbers with signs, fields add as arrows.

narration.en: Point charge: E = V/r. For a single point charge, kq/r² is just (kq/r)/r, so E = V/r. And remember: potentials add as plain numbers with signs, fields add as arrows.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. V = W/q; 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹; ವಿಭವ ಅದಿಶ. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶ V = kq/r; ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ V = kp cosθ/r². ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳ ವಿಭವಗಳು ಬೀಜಗಣಿತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ. E = −dV/dr: ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವು ವಿಭವ ಇಳಿಯುವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
